privacy.body:
1. General information

This Privacy Policy defines the rules for processing personal data of users of the Aura Catch mobile application and web platform (the "Application").

The Data Controller is:
Dariusz Szweda
ul. Batalionów Chłopskich 15
41-400 Mysłowice, Poland

For all personal data protection matters, you can contact us at: office@auracatch.com

2. Scope of processed data

Aura Catch processes only the following user data:
- email address provided during account registration or sign-in.

The Controller does not process special categories of personal data or sensitive data.

The Application uses camera and microphone access. Image and voice are processed temporarily by the Gemini AI API to recognize products and are immediately removed from memory (Zero Retention). We do not store photos or voice recordings on our servers.

3. Purposes of processing

Personal data is processed solely to:
- create and maintain a user account,
- enable use of the Application features,
- handle technical and account security communication,
- fulfill legal obligations,
- prevent abuse and ensure service security.

4. Legal basis for processing

Personal data is processed in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), based on:
- Article 6(1)(b) GDPR — performance of a contract / electronic service provision,
- Article 6(1)(f) GDPR — legitimate interest of the Controller (security and proper Application operation),
- Article 6(1)(c) GDPR — compliance with legal obligations.

5. Data sharing

The Controller does not sell users’ personal data.

Data may be shared only with entities supporting the Application, such as:
- hosting providers,
- technical and infrastructure service providers,
- email service providers,
- IT security providers.

Data may be transferred outside the EEA only under mechanisms compliant with GDPR.

6. Affiliate links and partner programs

Aura Catch uses affiliate links and partner programs, including but not limited to:
- Amazon Associates,
- AWIN,
- Allegro Partner Program.

This means the Controller may receive a commission from qualifying purchases made through links available in the Application.

As an affiliate partner, we earn from qualifying purchases.

Clicking affiliate links may redirect users to external websites that have their own privacy policies and data processing rules.

The Controller is not responsible for privacy practices of third parties.

7. Price information and disclaimer

Aura Catch monitors product prices across multiple markets and online stores. Despite due diligence:
- prices shown in the Application may be delayed,
- prices may differ from current store prices,
- product availability may change,
- information may contain technical or synchronization errors.

The Controller does not guarantee completeness, correctness, or timeliness of presented prices and is not liable for purchasing decisions made based on data shown in the Application.

The binding product price is always the one displayed directly by the seller at the time of purchase.

8. Data retention

8.1. For FREE plan users: tracked product data is removed from the database 30 days after the tracking period ends.

8.2. Account data is stored until the user uses the "Delete account and data" feature.

9. User rights

The user has the right to:
- access their data,
- rectify data,
- erase data,
- restrict processing,
- data portability,
- object to processing,
- lodge a complaint with a competent supervisory authority.

In Poland, the supervisory authority is the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (PUODO).

10. Data security

The Controller applies appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against loss, unauthorized access, or disclosure.

Super admin, administrator, or any helper of the website administrator does not and will never have access to users’ private financial data.

11. Privacy Policy updates

The Controller reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy. The current version will be published in the Application and on the website.

1. General provisions

The owner of the Aura Catch website and application is Dariusz Szweda.

These Terms of Service define the rules for using the Aura Catch mobile application and web platform.

Using the Application means accepting these Terms.

2. Application functionality

Aura Catch enables users to monitor product prices across 31 markets and access offer and promotion information.

The Application is informational and supportive in nature.

The Controller is not the seller of products presented in the Application and does not participate in concluding sales contracts between the user and a store or marketplace platform.

3. Subscription rules and limits (FREE plan)

3.1. A FREE plan user can track a product for 30 days from the moment it is added.

3.2. In the FREE plan, the price is updated once per day (every 24 hours), around the time when the product was added to the database.

3.3. After 30 days, tracking ends and historical product data is archived in accordance with the Privacy Policy.

4. User account

Creating an account requires providing an email address.

The user is obliged to provide truthful data and not share the account with third parties.
